name: Programmatic LLM Interaction
outcome: Access an LLM programmatically and handle its responses safely.
description: Call an existing language model from Python through an API or compatible interface. Configure requests, handle responses and errors, protect credentials and record relevant model settings.
external: Basic Python, command-line use, package environments and basic HTTP/JSON concepts.
learn: Send model requests from Python and interpret responses
Handle errors, timeouts and credentials safely
Record model identifiers and request settings
moduleDescriptions: Inspect an OpenAI-compatible request, response and model configuration.
Send a Python request to a supplied local or institutional endpoint.
Handle timeouts, HTTP errors and credentials without exposing secrets.
Record request settings, validate responses and rerun a small experiment.
prerequisiteRationale: F02 supplies prompt design and model-response literacy; A01 introduces the programmatic interface.
